psychological_meaning: Stratos evokes feelings of mystery, depth, and sophistication. As a deep, dark hue, it is often associated with the night sky, the unknown, and a sense of quiet power. It can inspire introspection and a feeling of calm intensity, while also suggesting exclusivity and elegance.
